text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder why.
I just had a feeling you'd be waiting for me here today.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
...I was waiting.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe
wants to say "thank you"……
to Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""SISR"...—
I heard it at the previous Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "The 'TIFY' of Neo Universe and the others... one of its... 'possibilities.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Quasar."
...It was 『superb』.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so happy. To see you rejoice this much...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That's why... I'll return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth.
From now on, together with Neo Universe—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Let's jam.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What did you say...!?
A session with Universe-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That's just—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that the greatest?!
Let's do it, absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: By the way, Neo Universe... 『likes』 progressive rock.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me, Universe-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"There is no music that I, Sounds of Earth,
cannot play!!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira...!
"High-spirited" with "transcendent technique," indeed...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haha—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (Grazie, Universe-san...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(I will never, ever forget tonight's session
for the rest of my life...!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Let's jam.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Th-This is... !?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear it?
"SOND"... the 'sound' of the stars.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah!
I don't really get it, but I totally get it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I see, what fills this place right now
is the breath of the cosmos...! The song of the stars...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You guided me to this sea, didn't you...!
Then, I shall answer your call...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's 'Music Time.'

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Amazing...!
I've never had a session like this before...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Is this the dorm...!?
Wait, was that a dream just now...?!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(...It's still vividly lingering.
The sound you gave me—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (So this... is not a dream...—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Grazie, Universe-san.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"What you gave me in return...
I will never forget it for the rest of my life."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Let's jam.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ......Where... am I――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: With who you are right now—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Having run so many races and carried so many hopes with you, you should surely be able to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The sound of "me" and "all of us."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Aah... what a disaster...—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I can hear it...! So many sounds... so many melodies...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The music that once was...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: A symphony of what could have been...!!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ……Again, Earth.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Right here, I want to turn your current music
into everyone's sound...—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I want to hear it. From as close as possible.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A harmony between you and us.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I will play a lot.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So……
Let me hear lots of everyone's sounds.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure you will forget this time.
However—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Music endures forever.
Through music, we can always stay connected.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This music... is the bond between Earth and me—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Morning~.
So yesterday during training—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
—Eh, there's a test today!?
No way, let me see your notes for a sec, please—

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I told them straight out:
‘You're gonna get fat if you keep doing that’—”

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
—Haa~, such nice weather~...
Seriously, I'm so sleepy today...—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Buongiorno, Universe-san!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
May wonderful music
be with you today as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To wonderful music.
Sounds of Earth—
